prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic original artistic interpretation (not a photograph) of Castillo de Colomares in Benalmadena, Spain, at night. Night light: soft floodlighting on the monument facades, gardens dark, clear sky, 21 degrees C, light breeze; illumination is an artistic interpretation. Main subject centered to survive a 4:5 center crop. No identifiable people, no legible logos, no text, lettering or signs anywhere. Keep the lower third clean and uncluttered.
